note: KeyboardEvent.code -> macos virtual keycode for CGEventCreateKeyboardEvent. keycode is decimal; name is its kVK_* constant in HIToolbox/Events.h. the host joins this file with keymap.json by code into one table from (scancode, extended) to keycode: the session hands the injector set-1 scancodes and never a code, so the two files must agree on every code. every code keymap.json gives a scancode is in codes or in exceptions with its reason, and input/mac.rs tests that it is. injection is by keycode, so the host's keyboard layout decides what a key types, as the scancode does on windows.
dropped: never reaching this table: PrintScreen, whose sequence is e0 2a e0 37 (no mac key means it, and the conventional F13 moves the brightness on some macs), and Pause, a virtual key (the conventional F15 does the same). the injector drops both, and any scancode not here, with a debug line.

IntlBackslash.name: kVK_ISO_Section
IntlBackslash.note: the iso key beside left shift, as chromium maps it. an iso mac reports the key left of 1 under this keycode too, so the two can swap there, the same as in a browser on that mac.

Backspace.name: kVK_Delete
Backspace.note: the mac names backspace delete; forward delete is Delete's keycode.

ContextMenu.name: kVK_ContextualMenu
ContextMenu.note: the pc menu key, as chromium maps it; few mac apps act on it.

MetaLeft.name: kVK_Command
MetaLeft.note: command. the viewer has already moved ctrl to cmd where its swap setting asks (keymap.ts), so this is the key the viewer meant.

Lang1.name: kVK_JIS_Kana
Lang1.note: the kana key of a jis mac keyboard.

Lang2.name: kVK_JIS_Eisu
Lang2.note: the eisu (alphanumeric) key of a jis mac keyboard.

Insert.name: kVK_Help
Insert.note: a mac has no insert: an apple extended keyboard puts help where insert is, and a pc keyboard's insert reaches a mac as help. chromium maps it the same way.

NumLock.name: kVK_ANSI_KeypadClear
NumLock.note: a mac has no num lock; keypad clear sits where it is, and a pc keyboard's num lock reaches a mac as clear.

F13.name: kVK_F13
F13.note: a real key on an apple extended keyboard; on some macs it moves the brightness.

F14.name: kVK_F14
F14.note: a real key on an apple extended keyboard; on some macs it moves the brightness.

F15.name: kVK_F15
F15.note: a real key on an apple extended keyboard; on some macs it moves the brightness.

AudioVolumeDown.name: kVK_VolumeDown
AudioVolumeDown.note: the keycode older apple keyboards sent for this key. current macs send volume as a system-defined media event instead, so what a mac does with it is not established.

AudioVolumeMute.name: kVK_Mute
AudioVolumeMute.note: the keycode older apple keyboards sent for this key. current macs send volume as a system-defined media event instead, so what a mac does with it is not established.

AudioVolumeUp.name: kVK_VolumeUp
AudioVolumeUp.note: the keycode older apple keyboards sent for this key. current macs send volume as a system-defined media event instead, so what a mac does with it is not established.
